ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the $243M pause in Medicaid funds.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover potential fraud in the Medicaid program.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How did the Trump administration's pause in Medicaid funds affect the program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud in the Medicaid program, which could have far-reaching consequences for the state of Minnesota.
